title: Teddy's Farm Fiasco
custom_script:
# Scene: farm
Teddy: {point} I will fix this broken *fence* today! {fix:fence} [excited, point, creak]
Peddy: {walk-to} {laugh} Watch me help with *magic* instead! {turn:Teddy:pig} [happy, wave, magic]
Teddy: {oink} {shock} Haan?! Why am I a pig?! {turn:Teddy:back} [surprised, shrug, shout]
Peddy: {giggle} That was too fast! Try this! {turn:Teddy:frog} [happy, point, magic]
Teddy: {ribbit} {jump} Ribbit! I cannot hold a hammer! {gasp} [surprised, wave, boing]
Peddy: {hmm} {think} Let us make you bigger! {turn:Teddy:cow} [happy, point, magic]
Teddy: {moo} {uff} Mooo! Now I am too heavy! {facepalm} [sad, shrug, thud]
Peddy: {laugh} {point} You look so silly! {turn:Teddy:chicken} [happy, wave, magic]
Teddy: {cluck} {flap} Cluck cluck! My *fence* is still broken! {angry} [angry, hips, shout]
Peddy: {giggle} {chase} Come here and catch me! {run} [happy, wave, giggle]
Teddy: {cluck} {run} Wait right there, Peddy! {chase} [angry, point, shout]
# Scene: Village
Peddy: {run} {look-around} Over here by the river! {cross:bridge} [excited, wave, footsteps]
Teddy: {cluck} {chase} Stop running with your *magic*! {cross:bridge} [angry, point, shout]
Peddy: {giggle} {turn:Teddy:horse} Gallop faster, slowpoke! {run} [happy, wave, magic]
Teddy: {neigh} {jump} Neigh! Now I can run fast! {chase} [excited, point, boing]
Peddy: {wow} {step-back} Whoa, you got quick! {turn:Teddy:back} [surprised, wave, magic]
Teddy: {uff} {point} Give me back my tools! {run} [angry, hips, shout]
Peddy: {laugh} {hide:bush} Too late, I am hiding! {giggle} [happy, point, rustle]
Teddy: {look:bush} {sniff} I see your sneakers, Peddy! {walk-to} [suspicious, think, footsteps]
Peddy: {oops} {jump} Peekaboo! {turn:Teddy:duck} [happy, wave, magic]
Teddy: {quack} {flap} Quack! Stop turning me into birds! {angry} [angry, hips, shout]
Peddy: {laugh} {run} Catch me if you can! {chase} [happy, wave, giggle]
# Scene: jungle by the river
Peddy: {run} {climb:mango tree} Up in the tree I go! {shake:tree} [excited, wave, rustle]
Teddy: {quack} {swim:river} I will go around the water! {splash} [angry, point, splash]
Peddy: {pick:mango} {throw:mango} Catch this fruit, quacker! {laugh} [happy, point, whoosh]
Teddy: {duck} {eat:mango} {wow} Hey, that mango is good! {smile} [happy, nod, eat]
Peddy: {climb-down} {jump} Time for another trick! {turn:Teddy:monkey} [happy, point, magic]
Teddy: {ooo} {jump} Ooo ooo! Now I can climb too! {climb:mango tree} [excited, wave, boing]
Peddy: {shock} {step-back} Hey, get down from there! {run} [surprised, wave, gasp]
Teddy: {monkey} {jump} Catch me in the branches! {chase} [happy, point, giggle]
Peddy: {uff} {run} My legs are getting tired! {turn:Teddy:back} [surprised, shrug, pant]
Teddy: {point} {run} Now you cannot escape! {chase} [angry, point, shout]
# Scene: farm
Peddy: {run} {look-around} Back to the farm we go! {run} [scared, wave, footsteps]
Teddy: {chase} {run} You cannot hide in the barn! {run} [angry, point, shout]
Peddy: {giggle} {turn:Teddy:sheep} Baaa! Slow down, woolly! {laugh} [happy, wave, magic]
Teddy: {baa} {jump} Baaa! Why am I woolly again?! {angry} [surprised, hips, shout]
Peddy: {run} {look-around} Watch out for the mud! {step-back} [surprised, point, gasp]
Teddy: {baa} {run} I am coming for you! {chase} [angry, point, footsteps]
Peddy: {giggle} {turn:Teddy:back} Okay, okay, you are you! {wave} [happy, wave, magic]
Teddy: {uff} {run} Too late for sorry! {chase} [angry, point, shout]
Peddy: {oops} {look-around} Look out ahead! {shock} [surprised, point, gasp]
Teddy: {run} {fall} {crash:tractor} Whoaaa! Crash! {dizzy} [surprised, wave, crash]
Peddy: {gasp} {walk-to} Teddy! Are you okay?! {shock} [surprised, wave, gasp]
Teddy: {dizzy} {shake-head} My head is spinning like a wheel! {uff} [sad, shrug, boing]
Peddy: {laugh} {point} Look at the tractor and the *fence*! {giggle} [happy, wave, laugh]
Teddy: {look-around} {hmm} {laugh} That is a giant mess! {laugh} [happy, shrug, laugh]
Peddy: {sit} {laugh} Let us just sit right here! {laugh} [happy, wave, laugh]
Teddy: {sit} {laugh} {haha} We chased each other in circles! {laugh} [happy, nod, laugh]
Peddy: {laugh} {clap} A pig, a frog, a cow, a chicken! {laugh} [happy, clap, laugh]
Teddy: {laugh} {smile} And a horse, a duck, a monkey, a sheep! {laugh} [happy, wave, laugh]
Peddy: {laugh} {high-five} Best farm fiasco ever! {yay} [happy, wave, applause]
Teddy: {laugh} {high-five} Next time, we fix the *fence* first! {laugh} [happy, nod, laugh]
# Scene: farm
Teddy: {point} {look-around} Still, look at that bent *fence*! {hmm} [suspicious, think, sigh]
Peddy: {giggle} {turn:Teddy:pig} Want another quick *magic* spin? {laugh} [happy, point, magic]
Teddy: {oink} {laugh} Oink! No more magic today! {laugh} [happy, wave, laugh]
Peddy: {laugh} {turn:Teddy:back} {hug} Deal, my funny friend! {laugh} [happy, wave, laugh]
# Scene: farm
Teddy: {stand-up} {look-around} The tractor has a tiny scratch! {hmm} [surprised, think, gasp]
Peddy: {laugh} {point} And the *fence* looks like a noodle! {giggle} [happy, wave, laugh]
Teddy: {laugh} {shake-head} How did we end up like this? {laugh} [happy, shrug, laugh]
Peddy: {giggle} {jump} Because I cast a spell! {laugh} [happy, wave, boing]
Teddy: {laugh} {point} And I tried to tackle you! {laugh} [happy, point, laugh]
Peddy: {laugh} {clap} That crash was so loud! {laugh} [happy, clap, laugh]
Teddy: {laugh} {smile} My hat is still in the hay! {laugh} [happy, nod, laugh]
Peddy: {laugh} {high-five} What a crazy afternoon! {yay} [happy, wave, applause]
# Scene: Village
Peddy: {run} {look-around} Remember when we crossed the bridge? {laugh} [happy, wave, footsteps]
Teddy: {chase} {laugh} You turned me into a horse! {laugh} [happy, point, laugh]
Peddy: {giggle} {jump} You ran like the wind! {laugh} [happy, wave, boing]
Teddy: {laugh} {shake-head} Then you turned me right back! {laugh} [happy, shrug, laugh]
Peddy: {laugh} {hide:bush} I thought that bush would hide me! {laugh} [happy, point, rustle]
Teddy: {laugh} {point} Your shoes were sticking right out! {laugh} [happy, point, laugh]
Peddy: {oops} {laugh} Then I made you a duck! {laugh} [happy, wave, giggle]
Teddy: {quack} {laugh} Quack! I was so mad! {laugh} [happy, nod, laugh]
# Scene: jungle by the river
Peddy: {climb:mango tree} {laugh} Up in the mango tree I went! {laugh} [happy, wave, rustle]
Teddy: {swim:river} {laugh} And I splashed across the river! {laugh} [happy, wave, splash]
Peddy: {pick:mango} {laugh} I threw a mango right at you! {laugh} [happy, point, whoosh]
Teddy: {eat:mango} {laugh} And I ate it mid-chase! {laugh} [happy, nod, eat]
Peddy: {jump} {laugh} Then you became a monkey! {laugh} [happy, wave, boing]
Teddy: {monkey} {laugh} Ooo ooo! Climbing trees like a pro! {laugh} [happy, point, giggle]
Peddy: {uff} {laugh} You chased me through the leaves! {laugh} [happy, shrug, pant]
Teddy: {laugh} {smile} Best workout of the year! {laugh} [happy, nod, laugh]
# Scene: farm
Peddy: {sit} {laugh} Look at all the farm animals watching! {laugh} [happy, wave, laugh]
Teddy: {laugh} {point} Even the cows are staring at us! {laugh} [happy, point, laugh]
Peddy: {giggle} {clap} They think we are a comedy show! {laugh} [happy, clap, laugh]
Teddy: {laugh} {shake-head} Maybe we are! {laugh} [happy, shrug, laugh]
Peddy: {laugh} {high-five} A wizard and a crash-test Teddy! {yay} [happy, wave, applause]
Teddy: {laugh} {high-five} That is a great team name! {laugh} [happy, nod, laugh]
# Scene: farm
Teddy: {sit} {laugh} My knee hurts a little bit! {uff} [sad, shrug, boing]
Peddy: {laugh} {turn:Teddy:frog} Want a frog hop to feel better? {laugh} [happy, point, magic]
Teddy: {ribbit} {jump} Ribbit! No hopping right now! {laugh} [happy, wave, boing]
Peddy: {laugh} {turn:Teddy:back} {hug} Back to normal in a flash! {laugh} [happy, wave, laugh]
Teddy: {laugh} {smile} Good thing your *magic* wears off! {laugh} [happy, nod, laugh]
Peddy: {giggle} {clap} Mostly when I remember the spell! {laugh} [happy, clap, laugh]
Teddy: {laugh} {point} Hey, you remembered every single one! {laugh} [happy, point, laugh]
Peddy: {laugh} {high-five} Only because you kept chasing me! {yay} [happy, wave, applause]
# Scene: farm
Teddy: {look-around} {laugh} The tractor is leaning sideways! {laugh} [happy, point, laugh]
Peddy: {laugh} {giggle} It looks like it is taking a nap! {laugh} [happy, wave, laugh]
Teddy: {laugh} {shake-head} And the *fence* is completely crooked! {laugh} [happy, shrug, laugh]
Peddy: {laugh} {clap} We did not fix a single post! {laugh} [happy, clap, laugh]
Teddy: {laugh} {smile} Instead we broke even more stuff! {laugh} [happy, nod, laugh]
Peddy: {giggle} {jump} By accident, of course! {laugh} [happy, wave, boing]
Teddy: {laugh} {high-five} Total accident, one hundred percent! {laugh} [happy, nod, laugh]
Peddy: {laugh} {clap} Let us keep laughing before anyone comes! {laugh} [happy, clap, laugh]
# Scene: farm
Teddy: {sit} {laugh} Hahaha! Look at that bent gate! {laugh} [happy, wave, laugh]
Peddy: {laugh} {giggle} Hahaha! Look at your muddy boots! {laugh} [happy, point, laugh]
Teddy: {laugh} {shake-head} Hahaha! I crashed into a tractor! {laugh} [happy, shrug, laugh]
Peddy: {laugh} {clap} Hahaha! And I turned you into four animals! {laugh} [happy, clap, laugh]
Teddy: {laugh} {smile} Hahaha! My hat is still in the dirt! {laugh} [happy, nod, laugh]
Peddy: {laugh} {high-five} Hahaha! Best farm disaster ever! {yay} [happy, wave, applause]
Teddy: {laugh} {high-five} Hahaha! We should do it again tomorrow! {laugh} [happy, nod, laugh]
Peddy: {laugh} {hug} Hahaha! Deal, see you at the *fence*! {laugh} [happy, wave, laugh]
